name: underline-animation
title: Underline Animation
description: Underline Animation is a React link component: a CSS hover underline, animated, written in plain CSS. The line is painted as a background on the link itself rather than a pseudo-element, so with box-decoration-break it follows the text across line breaks and every wrapped line gets its own underline. Five variants: slide draws in from the left on hover and leaves to the right, center grows out from the middle, fill turns a thin resting line into a soft highlight behind the words, wavy draws a wavy underline in from the left that keeps its shape as it grows, and gradient slides in a two color line. Hover, keyboard focus and the active prop all show the line, so the current page in a nav can keep its underline, and a faint resting line keeps links in running text discoverable. Reduced motion shows the line at once. The stylesheet is injected once, with no global CSS or dependencies.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>
